## Problem and change

Explain the participant-facing problem and resulting behavior.

## Sources and decisions

- Legal/rule changes: official pinpoint sources, review dates, exceptions, approval.
- Privacy/survey/metric changes: definitions, disclosure impact, approval reference.
- State “not applicable” where appropriate; do not imply approval merely by checking a box.

## Validation

- [ ] Foundation check passed (`node scripts/validate-foundation.mjs`).
- [ ] Applicable behavior, accessibility and privacy checks listed below.
- [ ] No private participant data, credentials, raw responses or real-case fixtures.
- [ ] Pending rules remain disabled; sample and evidence limits are preserved.

Describe tests actually run and any remaining release gates.
